title: Susan Collins Criticizes Rival’s ‘Oh, Shut Up’ Comment as ‘Very Telling’
summary: Ms. Collins, a Republican running in a crucial race, said the debate remark by Troy Jackson reflects how he treats women. Mr. Jackson has defended his comment, and his campaign said Ms. Collins had run a campaign based on personal attacks.
